sloka: चक्रवाकैः सकारण्डैः सहंसजलकुक्कुटैः ।सारसैश्च सदा मत्तैः सुकूजद्भिः समावृताम् ।। ७.३१.२१ ॥
transliteration: cakravākaiḥ sakāraṇḍaiḥ sahaṁsajalakukkuṭaiḥ ।sārasaiśca sadā mattaiḥ sukūjadbhiḥ samāvṛtām ।। 7.31.21 ॥

translations.english: The river was surrounded by chakravaka birds, karanda ducks, swans, water-hens, and sarasa cranes, all always joyful and sweetly cooing.
